cohort: The study included 385 women who underwent obstetric fistula repair surgery at the Mettu Hamlin Fistula Center between 2015 and 2020.
finding: Obstetric fistula repair failure occurred in 18.2% of participants, with larger fistula size, urethral damage, home delivery, and malnutrition significantly increasing the probability of failure.
mod_finding: Home delivery was significantly associated with a 5-fold increased probability of obstetric fistula repair failure.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from records of surgeries performed between 2015 and 2020.
